summary: Completed frontend-only testing of NeXify Next.js app after production mode fix. CRITICAL SUCCESS: React hydration is now working correctly - the app is fully interactive. All required features verified: chat open/close, layout changes, resize handle, hero video element, responsive layout, and mobile overlay.

minor_issues.issue: Focus chips (.action-option) are present in DOM and visible in screenshots, but Playwright click test reports 'element is not visible'. This appears to be a test automation visibility detection issue rather than a functional problem.
minor_issues.impact: Could not fully verify focus chip click interaction, but chips are clearly present and rendered correctly
minor_issues.note: Chips are visible in all screenshots with correct text: 'Marke & Web', 'Systeme & KI', 'Ads & Marketing'
